Bees are primarily known for producing honey, beeswax, propolis, royal jelly, and pollen. Honey is the most famous product, a sweet, viscous substance made from the nectar of flowers. Beeswax is used in the construction of honeycomb structures within the hive. Propolis is a resinous mixture that bees collect from tree buds and use to seal gaps in the hive. Royal jelly is a secretion used to feed queen bees and young larvae. Pollen is collected by bees as a protein source for the colony.
